output.title: Access to export-controlled (ITAR) drawing folders in the vault
output.applies_when: A user cannot open or is denied access to an export-controlled / ITAR drawings folder, often after joining a program team or after a portal folder request was rejected because controlled folders are not covered.

steps.text: Recognise the case: the standard portal folder request does not cover controlled folders, so a rejection there is expected for these folders.

quotes.quote: Folder request in the portal was rejected; it says controlled folders are not covered.
I joined the program team and need the controlled drawings folder for panel_599.asm.

steps.text: Route the request to Trade Compliance for screening.

quotes.quote: Routed to Trade Compliance for screening
Routed to Trade Compliance for screening

steps.text: After screening, the vault admin grants access to the controlled folder.

quotes.quote: then access granted by vault admin.
then access granted by vault admin.

unknowns: How to route to Trade Compliance: which queue, form, or contact to use.
What information Trade Compliance needs for screening (e.g. citizenship/person status, program, folder or file names).
Who approves besides Trade Compliance (e.g. program manager or folder owner), if anyone.
How the vault admin is engaged after screening and which team or queue that is.
Expected timings for screening and access grant (median resolution is 50.0 hours across 201 tickets).
What the user should be told if screening is not passed.
Whether users can request this directly instead of opening an incident, to avoid the rejected portal request.
